A single invalid flipper length of -195 mm (row 13) was set to missing as it was below the valid range (170–235 mm). After fixes, the average flipper length is 189.44 mm for Adelie, 193.85 mm for Chinstrap, and 217.44 mm for Gentoo penguins.
